messages:
rachel: Quick postmortem follow-up: need owners/timelines for KV-eviction remediation and test additions (regression entries, prompt vectors, load/chaos).

omar: I can own promptset + regression entries. Will curate 80 vectors (sanitized sample + synthetics). PR by 2025-07-12.

lee: I'll own load profiles + chaos harness. Two profiles: steady 200rps 30m and short spike 100->800rps. Replica-isolate scenario for 30s. Draft k6 + runbook in 48h.

rachel: @ci-bot please add canary gate: fail deploy if p99/p999 latency or kv-miss delta exceed thresholds. Also nightly full reg-suite.

ci-bot: Added JOB-8311: canary-regressions job. Gate rules: p99<130ms, p999<300ms, kv-miss delta<7%.

omar: Promptset stored at tests/promptsets/kv-eviction-2025.json; includes baseline metrics and expected kv_hit_rate per vector.

lee: Chaos snippet (safe-tooling): run_load(profile="spike", rps=[100,800], duration=120); wait 30s; isolate_replica("replica-2",30s); abort if p99>500ms or errors>0.5%.

rachel: Ops: create ticket to track owners + exec brief. Also add recurrence detection item to tag future incidents matching KV-tail.

sre-bot: Created TICKET-8420: "KV eviction remediation + tests" assigned to omar,lee,rachel due 2025-07-20.

omar: Will open PR and tag reviewers today.

lee: I'll post chaos runbook in #runbooks and link dashboards.

rachel: Thanks team — single owners, CI gating, and recurrence tagging. Keep updates on TICKET-8420. :thumbsup:
